subject: Literature
title: Neil Gaiman and Myth Retold
description: Learn Neil Gaiman and Myth Retold in one minute.

hook.text: Neil Gaiman's American Gods imagined ancient deities as immigrants struggling to survive in modern America.

buildup.text: Old gods like Odin and Anansi compete against new gods of technology, media, and the internet for believers.

discovery.text: Gaiman later retold Norse mythology directly, making the original stories accessible to a new generation.

twist.text: He argued that myths must be retold in each era or they die, because stories need living storytellers.

climax.text: Gaiman showed that mythology is not ancient history but a living tradition that adapts to every new world.

punchline.text: Old gods found new life in a modern novelist's hands.

quiz.question: What is the central conflict of American Gods?
options: A war between angels and demons
Old mythological gods competing with new gods of technology and media
A human discovering they are secretly a god
